options.text: The Image Validation add-on deploys an Azure Function App and supporting infrastructure to deploy and ensure the validation virtual machine is always using the latest image. This enables the security team to scan and validate your image before its release.

validations.message: Select a deployment subscription.

elements.name: location
elements.label: Region
elements.toolTip: Region for the resource group and function app infrastructure. Verify Windows Dedicated plan and PowerShell runtime availability in this cloud and region.

options.text: Configure the settings for the validation virtual machine.

elements.name: size
elements.label: Size
elements.toolTip: Select the size of the validation virtual machine.

elements.name: bootDiagnostics
elements.label: Boot diagnostics
elements.toolTip: Use this feature to troubleshoot boot failures for custom or platform images. Boot diagnostics with managed storage account significantly improves creation time of Virtual machines by using pre-provisioned storage accounts managed by Microsoft.

elements.name: gallery
elements.label: Compute gallery
elements.toolTip: Select the compute gallery containing the image for the validation VM.

elements.name: image
elements.label: Image
elements.toolTip: Select the compute gallery image for the validation VM.

options.text:
The following secrets must be stored in the key vault you select below:
1. LocalAdminUsername: The username of the local administrator on the virtual machine.
2. LocalAdminPassword: The password of the local administrator on the virtual machine.

elements.name: keyVault
elements.label: Key vault for secrets
elements.toolTip: Select the existing key vault containing LocalAdminUsername and LocalAdminPassword secrets. Enable template deployment on the vault and authorize the deployment principal. Do not enter credentials in the form.

elements.name: subnet
elements.label: Subnet
elements.toolTip: Select the subnet for the validation VM.

constraints.allowedValues: [map(filter(steps('virtualMachine').network.subnetsApi.value, (item) => and(empty(item.properties.delegations), not(contains(item.name, 'Bastion')), not(contains(item.name, 'Firewall')))), (item) => parse(concat('{"label":"', item.name, '","value":"', item.id, '"}')))]

elements.name: privateIPAddress
elements.label: Private IPv4 address (static)
elements.toolTip: Enter an available IPv4 address in the selected VM subnet. Address availability and subnet membership must be checked before deployment.

validations.message: Enter an IPv4 address with four octets between 0 and 255.
The specified IP address is not available in the selected virtual network.

elements.name: securityType
elements.label: Security type
elements.toolTip: Security type refers to the different security features available for a virtual machine. Trusted launch helps to improve the security of Azure generation 2 virtual machines. However, not all VM configurations are supported when using this additional security feature.

elements.name: secureBoot
elements.label: Secure boot
elements.toolTip: Secure boot helps protect your VMs against boot kits, rootkits, and kernel-level malware.

elements.name: vTpm
elements.label: vTPM
elements.toolTip: Virtual Trusted Platform Module (vTPM) is TPM2.0 compliant and validates your VM boot integrity apart from securely storing keys and secrets.

elements.name: integrityMonitoring
elements.label: Integrity monitoring
elements.toolTip: Integrity monitoring enables cryptographic attestation and verification of VM boot integrity along with monitoring alerts if the VM didn't boot because attestation failed with the defined baseline.

options.text: Integrity monitoring
Integrity monitoring requires Secure Boot and vTPM to be enabled.

elements.name: encryptionAtHost
elements.label: Encryption At Host
elements.toolTip: Choose to enable Encryption At Host to encrypt temporary disks and disk caches at rest and during transfer to storage clusters.

elements.name: encryptionType
elements.label: Encryption type
elements.defaultValue: Double encryption with platform-managed and customer-managed keys
elements.toolTip: Enables a zero trust configuration on the session host disks.

allowedValues.label: Double encryption with platform-managed and customer-managed keys

options.text: Optionally customize your virtual machine by selecting custom scripts or software to install during deployment.

elements.name: addCustomScripts
elements.label: Add Custom Scripts or Software
elements.toolTip: Select this checkbox to add custom scripts or software installers to run during virtual machine deployment.

elements.name: storageAccount
elements.label: Storage account
elements.toolTip: Select the storage account containing your deployment artifacts.

elements.name: container
elements.label: Artifacts Container
elements.toolTip: Select the blob container which contains your artifact files.

elements.name: managedIdentity
elements.label: User-assigned identity
elements.toolTip: Select a user-assigned identity with the 'Storage Blob Data Reader' role assigned to the storage account selected above.

options.text: A managed identity with 'Storage Blob Data Reader' on the storage account is required when a storage account is selected or a blob storage URL is provided.
Custom Scripts and Software

Specify each customization's name, blob name (or full URI), optional arguments, and optional comma-separated success exit codes (default 0,3010). For array parameters, use @() syntax - e.g. -Domains @('site1.gov','site2.com').

validations.message: The value must not contain spaces or end or begin with a dash, underscore, or period.
Enter comma-separated integer exit codes, such as 0,3010.

elements.name: appServicePlanSku
elements.label: App service plan SKU
elements.toolTip: The SKU of the app service plan. These SKUs are pinned to the PremiumV3 tier for dedicated plans.

elements.name: schedule
elements.label: Cron schedule
elements.toolTip: Enter six NCRONTAB fields. The default value triggers daily at 9 PM.

validations.message: Enter six whitespace-separated NCRONTAB fields or an app-setting reference enclosed in percent signs.

elements.name: timeZone
elements.label: Time zone
elements.toolTip: The time zone for the timer schedule in the Function App.
